sections.en:
Under-tile membranes, primers and shower junctions

We match the under-tile membrane to the bathroom base and tiled finish. A water-based liquid membrane can be suitable where its product instructions cover the substrate and wet-area use. We coordinate the compatible primer, corner and pipe detailing, bond-breaking method and drain connection as one system. Specified film thickness and curing conditions guide the work; counting coats alone does not establish a complete membrane.

Compare waterproofing materials and system roles →
sections.zh:
瓷砖下防水膜、底涂与淋浴节点

我们按浴室基层和后续瓷砖饰面匹配瓷砖下防水系统。产品说明覆盖该基层和湿区用途时，可选用相应水性液态防水膜。我们将配套底涂、转角和管根节点、隔粘做法及排水口衔接统一安排。施工按规定膜厚与养护条件控制，不能只凭涂刷遍数判断防水层是否完整。

查看防水材料与系统配套说明 →

sections.en:
Exterior membrane selection beneath balcony tiles

For a tiled balcony, we check exterior and under-tile suitability together. Water-based does not mean indoor-only, while approval for outdoor use does not automatically permit permanent exposure. The selected membrane, primer, threshold and outlet details must work with the tile adhesive, falls and movement joints. We identify any protective covering and weather-dependent curing stages in the written scope.

Compare waterproofing materials and system roles →
sections.zh:
阳台瓷砖下的室外防水系统选材

铺砖阳台需同时核对室外与瓷砖下使用适用性。水性不代表只能室内使用，允许室外使用也不自动代表可长期外露。所选膜层、底涂、门槛和排水口节点，应与瓷砖胶、排水坡度及变形缝配合。我们在书面范围中明确所需保护覆盖层及受天气影响的养护阶段。

查看防水材料与系统配套说明 →

sections.en:
Exposed roof membranes and UV protection

We assess the roof surface and existing coating before selecting an exposed waterproofing system. A polyurethane liquid membrane and a sheet membrane have different preparation, junction and termination requirements; neither name establishes suitability for every roof. Some liquid systems require a compatible UV-resistant topcoat. We confirm the complete build-up, drainage and access requirements before agreeing the membrane work.

Compare waterproofing materials and system roles →
sections.zh:
外露屋面防水膜与紫外线保护

选择外露防水系统前，我们评估屋面及原有涂层。聚氨酯液态膜与卷材的基层处理、接缝和收口要求不同，名称本身不能证明适合所有屋面。部分液态系统需要相容的耐紫外线面层。我们在商定防水工作前，确认完整构造、排水及通行要求。

查看防水材料与系统配套说明 →

sections.en:
Pool membranes need permanent-immersion suitability

We check that the selected pool membrane is specified for permanent immersion and the actual pool base. Certain polymer-modified cementitious products suit immersed applications, but the category name alone is not approval. We coordinate the membrane with pipe penetrations, joints, tile adhesive, grout and the proposed water-treatment environment. Curing before tiling and curing before filling are separate stages in the selected system.

Compare waterproofing materials and system roles →
sections.zh:
泳池防水系统需适合长期浸水

我们核对所选泳池防水膜是否明确适用于长期浸水及实际池体基层。部分聚合物水泥基产品适合浸水环境，但类别名称不能代替产品适用说明。防水膜应与穿管、接缝、瓷砖胶、填缝料及拟采用的水处理环境配合。铺砖前和注水前的养护，是所选系统中的不同阶段。

查看防水材料与系统配套说明 →

sections.en:
Kitchen wet-zone preparation and compatible layers

We define the kitchen areas included in the waterproofing scope before selecting materials. The base, sink-side junctions, penetrations and planned finish determine the compatible primer, membrane and detailing. An epoxy moisture barrier has a different role from a flexible under-tile membrane; an easy-clean splashback or epoxy grout does not replace that membrane. Separate plumbing work remains identified in the quote.

Compare waterproofing materials and system roles →
sections.zh:
厨房涉水部位的基层与配套防水层

我们先明确厨房防水包含的区域，再选配材料。基层、水槽旁交接、穿管及拟定饰面，决定相容的底涂、防水膜和节点做法。环氧防潮阻隔层与柔性瓷砖下防水膜作用不同，易清洁防溅墙或环氧填缝也不能代替防水膜。独立水管工程仍在报价中另行明确。

查看防水材料与系统配套说明 →

sections.en:
Laundry membranes around wastes and pipe penetrations

We select the laundry membrane for the actual floor and wall base, then coordinate primer, pipe collars or specified tape, corners and waste connections. A moisture barrier for a damp substrate is not automatically the main wet-area membrane. We identify the moisture source and the selected product’s preparation and covering conditions before installation; appliance hoses and waste plumbing remain a separate trade scope.

Compare waterproofing materials and system roles →
sections.zh:
洗衣房排水口与穿管周边的防水系统

我们按实际墙地面基层选择洗衣房防水膜，并配合底涂、管根套环或规定的防水带、转角和排水口衔接。用于潮湿基层的防潮阻隔层，不自动等同湿区主体防水膜。施工前先确认水分来源，以及所选产品的基层与覆盖条件；电器软管和排水管工作仍属独立工种范围。

查看防水材料与系统配套说明 →

sections.en:
Wall substrates, water pressure and protective finishes

We assess the wall material, accessible water-entry details and whether the selected treatment will remain exposed or be covered. Polymer-modified cementitious coatings and other membranes have product-specific movement and water-pressure limits. A general wet-area membrane is not automatically suitable for negative-side pressure. The agreed wall work identifies compatible preparation, detailing and protection; separate window, drainage or structural work needs its own scope.

Compare waterproofing materials and system roles →
sections.zh:
墙体基层、水压方向与保护饰面

我们评估墙体材质、可接近的进水节点，以及所选处理层将外露还是被覆盖。聚合物水泥基涂层及其他防水膜，均有具体产品的变形与水压适用条件。普通湿区防水膜不自动适合背水面水压。约定的墙体工作需明确相容的基层处理、节点与保护；独立窗体、排水或结构工程另行确定范围。

查看防水材料与系统配套说明 →

sections.en:
System roles for different wet-area substrates

We identify the room use, substrate, drainage and planned finish before selecting the waterproofing layers. Primer, flexible membrane, joint sealant and moisture-control coating serve different roles. We check compatible corners, collars and bond-breaking details instead of assuming every product from one brand can be mixed. The written quote defines preparation, membrane coverage and any protection or tiling included.

Compare waterproofing materials and system roles →
sections.zh:
按不同湿区基层确认防水系统各层作用

我们先确认房间用途、基层、排水及拟定饰面，再选择防水各层材料。底涂、柔性防水膜、接缝密封胶及水分控制涂层各有作用。我们核对相容的转角件、套环和隔粘做法，不默认同品牌的所有产品都能混用。书面报价明确基层处理、防水覆盖范围及包含的保护层或铺砖工作。

查看防水材料与系统配套说明 →

sections.en:
Waterproofing materials and complete systems

Read the waterproofing materials guide

Are a primer, moisture barrier and sealant the same as a waterproofing membrane?

No. A primer prepares the bonding interface, a moisture barrier addresses specified moisture or vapour conditions, and a sealant treats designated joints. Their exact roles depend on the product. We specify the main membrane and compatible junction materials separately; a moisture-control coating is not automatically a flexible wet-area membrane.

Can a water-based membrane be used on a tiled balcony?

Some products are specified for exterior under-tile use. Water-based describes the formulation medium, not an indoor-only use category. We check the exact product, substrate, weather exposure, covering and tile-adhesive compatibility. Exterior suitability does not automatically mean the membrane can remain permanently exposed.

Does every polyurethane roof membrane resist long-term UV exposure?

No. Polyurethane describes the chemistry, not the complete exposure rating. Some roof systems require a specified UV-resistant topcoat over the base membrane. We assess the existing roof and agree the compatible primer, membrane, detailing and protection together. A generic coating name is not a complete roof specification.

Is a cementitious membrane always rigid or suitable for any pool?

Neither assumption is reliable. Polymer-modified cementitious ranges include flexible products, but movement, immersion and water-pressure suitability are product-specific. For a pool, we check permanent immersion, the base, water treatment, tile adhesive, grout and curing before filling as one system. A membrane suitable for rain exposure is not automatically suitable for continuous immersion.

Are two or three coats enough to confirm waterproofing is complete?

Coat count alone is not enough. The selected system specifies preparation, coverage, film thickness, junction treatment, recoat conditions and curing before covering or use. We follow those product requirements and agree any project checks. A surface that looks dry may not be ready for tiling, rain exposure or pool filling.

Can tapes, sealants and membranes from the same brand always be mixed?

No. We check the nominated system’s approved components and detailing method. Corners, pipe collars, tape and bond-breaking treatments have specific roles; one approved tape detail may replace a separate bond breaker in that system, while another system needs a different method. Tile adhesive and protective topcoats also need compatibility confirmed.
sections.zh:
防水材料与完整系统

阅读防水材料指南

底涂、防潮阻隔层和密封胶，等同防水膜吗？

不等同。底涂处理粘结界面，防潮阻隔层针对规定的水分或水汽条件，密封胶处理指定接缝，具体作用取决于产品。我们分别明确主体防水膜及相容节点材料，不能把水分控制涂层自动当作柔性湿区防水膜。

水性防水膜可以用于铺砖阳台吗？

部分产品明确适用于室外瓷砖下。水性描述配方介质，并不等于只能室内使用。我们核对具体产品、基层、风雨暴露、覆盖层及瓷砖胶兼容性。适合室外也不自动代表防水膜可长期外露。

所有聚氨酯屋面防水膜都能长期耐晒吗？

不是。聚氨酯描述化学体系，并不代表完整的外露性能。部分屋面系统需要在主体膜上施工规定的耐紫外线面层。我们评估现有屋面，一并确定相容底涂、防水膜、节点与保护层，不能只凭涂层类别代替完整屋面选材。

水泥基防水一定是刚性材料，或都适合泳池吗？

这两种判断都不能一概而论。聚合物水泥基系列包含柔性产品，但变形、浸水及水压适用性需按具体型号确认。泳池要将长期浸水、基层、水处理、瓷砖胶、填缝与注水前养护作为完整系统核对。适合淋雨的膜不自动适合持续浸水。

刷两遍或三遍，就能确认防水完成了吗？

单看遍数不够。所选系统规定基层处理、涂布量、膜厚、节点处理、复涂条件及覆盖或使用前的养护。我们按产品要求安排施工并明确项目所需检查。表面看起来干燥，不一定已适合铺砖、淋雨或泳池注水。

同品牌的防水带、密封胶和防水膜，都可以混用吗？

不能默认混用。我们核对选定系统认可的配件及节点方法。转角件、管根套环、防水带和隔粘处理各有作用；某系统认可的防水带做法可能替代独立隔粘材料，其他系统则可能采用不同做法。瓷砖胶与保护面层也需确认兼容性。
